title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report
best_for_zh: 审计模型报告的数据披露边界
one_line: DeepSeek-V3 discloses aggregate pretraining scale and a high-level SFT/RL post-training sequence, but not the data lineage or feedback contract needed to audit the recipe.
DeepSeek-V3 披露了聚合预训练规模与高层 SFT/RL 后训练顺序，但未披露审计该配方所需的数据谱系和反馈合约。
why: It makes the difference between a model technical report and a reproducible reasoning-data pipeline explicit.
inclusion_reason: A primary frontier technical report that discloses model and aggregate training scale plus a high-level SFT-to-RL sequence while withholding material data-lineage and feedback-contract fields.

title: Problem
问题
html: A frontier model report can disclose architecture and aggregate compute while still leaving the reasoning-data pipeline unauditable. DeepSeek-V3 is more informative than a stage-name summary because it describes how long-CoT teacher traces, domain experts, rejection sampling, rule rewards, learned rewards, and GRPO are combined. The remaining question is whether those disclosed mechanisms are sufficiently pinned by data manifests, selection logs, and feedback records to support reproduction.
前沿模型报告即使披露了架构和总体算力，也可能仍不足以审计推理数据流水线。DeepSeek-V3 的信息量高于仅列训练阶段的摘要，因为报告说明了长 CoT 教师轨迹、领域专家、拒绝采样、规则奖励、学习式奖励和 GRPO 如何组合。仍需追问的是：这些机制是否有数据清单、筛选日志和反馈记录支撑，从而达到可复现程度。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DeepSeek-V3 post-training starts from a 1.5M-instance instruction corpus. For math, competitive programming, and logic, an internal DeepSeek-R1 model supplies long reasoning responses; domain-specific SFT+RL experts learn to combine R1-style reflection and verification with shorter original responses, then generate traces retained by rejection sampling. DeepSeek-V2.5 generates non-reasoning responses that human annotators check. Two-epoch SFT is followed by GRPO using rule-based and model-based rewards across verifiable and open-ended domains. This is a disclosed construction recipe, but not a released dataset.

DeepSeek-V3 的后训练从 150 万条指令数据开始。针对数学、算法竞赛和逻辑任务，内部 DeepSeek-R1 模型提供长推理回答；各领域的 SFT+RL 专家学习把 R1 式反思与验证模式同较短的原始回答结合，再生成经拒绝采样保留的轨迹。非推理回答由 DeepSeek-V2.5 生成，并由人工核验。两轮 SFT 后，模型使用规则奖励与模型奖励执行 GRPO，覆盖可验证任务与开放任务。这是一套已披露的构造配方，但不是已发布的数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reasoning-data pipeline creates two sample forms for each instance: a problem paired with its original response, and an instruction prefix plus the problem paired with an R1 response. The instruction prefix asks for reflection and verification. A domain expert for code, mathematics, or general reasoning is trained with SFT and RL; high-temperature RL sampling blends patterns from the original and R1-generated responses over hundreds of steps. The expert then generates candidate answers, and rejection sampling selects the final concise, high-quality SFT traces. For creative writing, role play, and simple QA, DeepSeek-V2.5 generates responses and human annotators verify correctness. DeepSeek-V3-Base is fine-tuned on the 1.5M-instance mixture for two epochs with cosine learning-rate decay. Multiple samples are packed into a sequence, but sample masking prevents cross-example attention.

RL uses two feedback classes. Rule rewards check deterministic math answers in a required format and compile/run code against test cases. A reward model initialized from DeepSeek-V3 SFT checkpoints judges free-form answers against references and scores tasks without definitive ground truth. Its preference records include both the final reward and a chain of thought leading to that reward, intended to reduce reward hacking. GRPO samples a group of outputs per prompt and estimates the baseline from within-group rewards rather than a separate critic. RL prompts span code, math, writing, role play, and QA. For open-ended questions, the report also uses majority-voted judgments from DeepSeek-V3 itself as constitutional feedback.

推理数据流水线为每个实例构造两种样本：问题与原始回答的配对，以及指令前缀、问题与 R1 回答的组合。该指令前缀要求回答体现反思和验证。代码、数学或通用推理领域的专家模型先接受 SFT 和 RL；在数百个 RL step 中，采用高温采样融合原始回答与 R1 生成回答的模式。随后由专家生成候选答案，并通过拒绝采样选出兼顾质量与简洁性的最终 SFT 轨迹。创意写作、角色扮演和简单问答的回答由 DeepSeek-V2.5 生成，再由人工核验准确性。DeepSeek-V3-Base 在 150 万条混合数据上训练两个 epoch，采用余弦学习率衰减。多个样本会被打包进同一序列，但样本掩码阻止不同实例相互注意。

RL 使用两类反馈。规则奖励检查指定格式中的确定性数学答案，并编译代码、运行测试用例。由 DeepSeek-V3 SFT 检查点初始化的奖励模型，既判断自由格式回答是否匹配参考答案，也为没有确定标准答案的任务评分。偏好记录不仅包含最终奖励，还包含推导奖励的思维链，目的是降低 reward hacking。GRPO 为每条提示采样一组输出，以组内奖励估计基线，无需独立 critic。RL 提示覆盖代码、数学、写作、角色扮演和问答。对于开放问题，报告还采用 DeepSeek-V3 自身的多数投票结果作为宪法式反馈。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official report directly supports the 1.5M SFT count, teacher identities at the family level, two sample formats, expert-model generation, high-temperature RL, rejection sampling, human verification for non-reasoning data, two-epoch SFT, rule/model reward split, reward rationales, GRPO, and self-feedback by voting. It also reports extensive evaluations and an ablation in which R1-distilled math/code data improves task scores while increasing response length. Those results demonstrate reported behavior and a length-quality trade-off; they do not establish that the unreleased data are unbiased, uncontaminated, or reusable. The official repository and Hugging Face page verify released model artifacts, not the training corpus.

官方报告直接支持以下事实：150 万条 SFT、家族级教师身份、两种样本格式、专家模型生成、高温 RL、拒绝采样、非推理数据人工核验、两轮 SFT、规则/模型奖励划分、奖励推理依据、GRPO，以及多数投票式自反馈。报告还给出大量评测，并通过消融显示 R1 蒸馏的数学/代码数据提升任务分数，同时使回答变长。这些结果证明了报告所述行为及长度—质量权衡，但不能证明未发布数据无偏、无污染或可复用。官方代码仓库和 Hugging Face 页面核验的是模型工件，而不是训练语料。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The most useful contribution for reasoning-data research is the intermediate expert pipeline: long R1 traces are not copied directly into the final corpus. Instead, domain experts learn R1 reflection/verification patterns alongside original responses, then produce shorter candidates that pass rejection sampling. The reward side similarly separates deterministic rule feedback from learned judgment and records rationales for preference rewards. This makes DeepSeek-V3 a concrete example of controlling teacher-trace style and length rather than treating distillation as simple imitation.
对推理数据研究而言，最有价值的是中间专家流水线：R1 的长轨迹并非直接复制到最终语料。领域专家先同时学习 R1 的反思/验证模式与原始回答，再生成更简洁的候选，并经拒绝采样保留。反馈侧也把确定性规则反馈与学习式判断分开，并为偏好奖励记录推理依据。因此，DeepSeek-V3 展示的是如何控制教师轨迹的风格与长度，而不是把蒸馏简化为直接模仿。

title: Limitations
局限
html: No item-level SFT/RL release, source manifest, domain mixture, or license chain is provided. The exact internal R1 checkpoint, teacher prompts, high sampling temperature, candidate counts, rejection criteria, rejected traces, GRPO group size, rollout budget, reward calibration, preference-data volume, and human-review protocol remain unknown. Post-training splits and decontamination against evaluation sets are not documented at record level. Model-based rewards and self-voting can inherit policy bias, while reward rationales generated by a model do not by themselves guarantee resistance to reward hacking.
报告未发布逐条 SFT/RL 数据、来源清单、领域比例或许可链。内部 R1 的确切检查点、教师提示、高温采样数值、候选数量、拒绝标准、被拒轨迹、GRPO 组大小、rollout 预算、奖励校准、偏好数据规模和人工审核协议仍未知。后训练划分以及与评测集之间的去污染也没有记录级说明。模型奖励与自投票可能继承策略模型偏差；由模型生成奖励推理依据，也不能单独保证避免 reward hacking。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This Card is useful for comparing direct long-CoT distillation with expert-mediated trace construction. It identifies reusable record types—original responses, R1 responses, reflection prompts, expert rollouts, rejection decisions, rule outcomes, reward rationales, and GRPO groups—and shows where an audit would require missing manifests and logs. It also cautions practitioners to treat the released checkpoint, reported training recipe, and unreleased data as three different evidence layers.
本卡适合比较“直接长 CoT 蒸馏”与“专家模型中介的轨迹构造”。它明确了可复用的数据对象：原始回答、R1 回答、反思提示、专家 rollout、拒绝决策、规则结果、奖励推理依据和 GRPO 输出组，并指出审计这些对象仍需要哪些缺失清单与日志。它也提醒实践者把已发布检查点、报告中的训练配方和未发布训练数据视为三个不同证据层级。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §5.1 for the 1.5M-instance SFT mixture, expert-mediated R1 distillation, rejection sampling, and human-checked non-reasoning data.
  • Read §5.2 for rule versus model rewards, reward rationales, GRPO, and domain coverage.
  • Read §5.3.4 and §5.4.1 for majority-vote self-feedback and the accuracy-versus-length trade-off of R1 distillation.
  • Do not treat benchmark gains or released weights as evidence of corpus provenance or decontamination.

• §5.1 说明 150 万条 SFT 混合数据、专家中介的 R1 蒸馏、拒绝采样和人工核验的非推理数据。
  • §5.2 说明规则奖励与模型奖励、奖励推理依据、GRPO 和任务覆盖。
  • §5.3.4 与 §5.4.1 分别说明多数投票式自反馈，以及 R1 蒸馏的准确率—回答长度权衡。
  • 不应把基准提升或已发布权重当作语料来源与去污染证据。
